hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired pools that collects configurable swap fees via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, permanently locks LP positions (beforeRemoveLiquidity always reverts), applies a 60-second elevated antisniper fee window at launch, and routes collected fees to creator, auto-LP, buyback/burn, and rewards vaults.
